净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Sales yield (1/ps_ttm) is a stable value metric. When free-turn (attention) is low, the undervalued signal is stronger as neglected stocks have more room for correction. Multiplying sales yield by inattention (1 - rank of free_turn) amplifies the value effect when attention is low, and attenuates it when attention is high. Forward-fill is applied to both components to reduce missing values while p

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

1/ps_ttm * (1 - ts_rank(free_turn, 20)), with forward fill to reduce NaNs
依赖列: ps_ttm, free_turn

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(multiply(divide(1, ps_ttm), subtract(1, ts_rank(free_turn, 20))), add(1, ))
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, ps_ttm), subtract(1, ts_rank(free_turn, 20)))
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, ps_ttm)
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, ts_rank(free_turn, 20))
  5. 5. ts_rank —— 过去 N 天内排序分位(0~1)
    ts_rank(free_turn, 20)
  6. 6. add —— 加法
    add(1, )

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_rank滚动排名（当前值在 n 期窗口内的百分位排名）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sales_yield：1.0 / ps_ttm
  2. 计算 inattention：1.0 - free_turn.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)
  3. 计算 sales_yield：sales_yield.ffill()
  4. 计算 inattention：inattention.ffill()

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_attentive_sales_yield(df): df_copy = df.copy() sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) inattention = 1.0 - df_copy["free_turn"].rolling(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) sales_yield = sales_yield.ffill() inattention = inattention.ffill() df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield"] = sales_yield * inattention "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield"]
